records.label: Alliteration
records.action: Reran pinned CodexMusica plus the existing audited English contract on all 5778 occurrence pairs, in annotated and all-dictionary modes; retained positive-evidence alliteration witnesses.
records.research_method: Phonological onset agreement
records.research_scope: Native alliteration relation and audited English pair contracts; positive consonant evidence required. Pronunciation selection remains contextual.

records.label: Assonance
records.action: Reran pinned CodexMusica plus the existing audited English contract on all 5778 occurrence pairs, in annotated and all-dictionary modes; retained positive-evidence assonance witnesses.
records.research_method: Vowel agreement
records.research_scope: Native assonance relation; retain nonempty vowel evidence and pronunciation alternatives. Does not imply exclusivity with consonance.

records.label: Consonance
records.action: Reran pinned CodexMusica plus the existing audited English contract on all 5778 occurrence pairs, in annotated and all-dictionary modes; retained positive-evidence coda consonance witnesses.
records.research_method: Consonant/coda agreement
records.research_scope: Native consonance relation with positive consonant evidence; empty codas must not produce a match.

records.label: Rhyme
records.action: Reran pinned CodexMusica plus the existing audited English contract on all 5778 occurrence pairs, in annotated and all-dictionary modes; retained positive-evidence rhyme witnesses.
records.research_method: Stress-anchored phonological rhyme relations
records.research_scope: Existing rhyme schemas and corrected complete-rime comparisons. This confirms methods for rhyme, not universal support for every historical/performance-dependent subtype; missing judges remain missing.

records.label: Paroemion
records.action: Computed the source-declared nonempty onset fraction for every line; all 16 fractions are below 0.8.
records.limitation: Annotated selected pronunciation; onset_fraction rule reimplemented transparently in this-run adapter, not native full figure grader.
records.research_method: Native schema measures the fraction of line words sharing a phonological onset.
records.research_scope: Threshold 0.8 implements a nearly-every-word reading; reject or explicitly treat empty onsets and choose pronunciation alternatives before deployment.

records.label: Homoioteleuton (homoeoteleuton, homeoteleuton)
records.action: Reran the existing E63 bound-pair route on all 5778 pairs; five positive-evidence pairs remain.
records.limitation: Source-declared morphology scope; grammatical-affix identity is not thereby established.
records.research_method: Matching endings with declared morphology
records.research_scope: Native homoioteleuton schema plus existing bound-pair route; final nucleus, coda, prominence and declared affix condition. The chosen ending/morphological scope is explicit.

records.label: Anaphora
records.action: Executed PRD on all lines and all six sentences, with default and empty stop filters. Verified the full repeated line with bounded comparison.
records.limitation: Line-unit label; native no-stop line anaphora raises IndexError at the final duplicated lines.
records.research_method: Repeated beginnings
records.research_scope: Rhetorica FindAnaphora and PRD repeated-prefix rules; sentence/line units and thresholds require adaptation.

records.label: Epistrophe / epiphora
records.action: Executed PRD epiphora in both unit modes and stop policies; line ends sleep / sleep match.
records.limitation: Verse-line units, not two independent sentences.
records.research_method: Repeated endings
records.research_scope: Rhetorica FindEpistrophe and PRD terminal recurrence rules.

records.label: Symploce
records.action: Executed PRD combined anaphora/epiphora rule; it emits a line-unit symploce for the duplicate ending.
records.limitation: No variable middle. This is not unqualified symploce under narrower definitions.
records.research_method: Combined beginning and ending repetition
records.research_scope: Rhetorica FindSymploce and PRD combination; simultaneous component labels were exercised in the first run.

records.label: Anadiplosis
records.action: Executed PRD anadiplosis on the whole poem with line and sentence units and both stop policies; all four outputs are empty.
records.limitation: Scoped to the native boundary rule.
records.research_method: Ending-to-beginning recurrence
records.research_scope: Rhetorica FindAnadiplosis and PRD; excludes the weaker unordered-quarter shortcut in another package.

records.label: Epanalepsis
records.action: Executed PRD epanalepsis on the whole poem with line and sentence units and both stop policies; all four outputs are empty.
records.limitation: Scoped to the native boundary rule.
records.research_method: Beginning-to-ending recurrence
records.research_scope: Rhetorica FindEpanalepsis and PRD bounded recurrence.

records.label: Epizeuxis
records.action: Executed PRD phrase-capable epizeuxis; no-stop runs find final-line doubling. Bounded adapter verifies all 14 occurrences. Also checked all 107 adjacent word pairs: no single-word doubling.
records.limitation: Observed under phrase-inclusive source rule; strict single-word definition has no match. Native output context can extend one index past poem end; exact witness tokens were separately validated.
records.research_method: Adjacent word repetition
records.research_scope: Rhetorica FindEpizeuxis and PRD. Known span-handling defects in one implementation require repair, not invention of the method.

records.label: Diacope
records.action: Executed PRD diacope in all four modes and reviewed raw outputs. I think I and repeated final-line content words are formal matches.
records.limitation: Function-word matches and constituents of complete line repetition do not automatically establish a separate emphatic device.
records.research_method: Recurrence separated by intervening words
records.research_scope: Inspected diacope methods with explicit windows and witnesses.

records.label: Ploce
records.action: Enumerated all exact word recurrences and source-inspired content-word recurrence within two-sentence windows.
records.limitation: This-run exact lexical adapter. Rhetorica’s full tokenizer, stoplist and subsequence engine were not executed; rhetorical emphasis is not classified.
records.research_method: Rhetorica FindPloce enumerates recurring one-token content-word witnesses. This qualifies for the explicitly formal, unconstrained lexical-repetition sense.
records.research_scope: Default two-sentence window; stop words filtered. Does not establish emphasis, changed meaning, or every historical ploce sense.

records.label: Conduplicatio
records.action: Applied explicitly bounded 2–8 token, two-sentence, nonadjacent repeated-phrase enumeration; retained raw candidates from the final repetition.
records.limitation: The complete repeated lines are adjacent, so fail the source nonadjacency condition. Shorter subphrases can pass but are contained in the primary line repetition. Native Rhetorica was not executed.
records.research_method: FindConduplicatio finds repeated nonadjacent subsequences under the source-defined unpatterned lexical-repetition sense.
records.research_scope: Default minimum two tokens and two-sentence window; all-stop-word spans excluded. No emphasis or semantic-change decision.

records.label: Polyptoton
records.action: Reviewed word forms throughout poem; manually checked stop/stopping and dark/darkest and anchored both occurrence pairs.
records.limitation: An inflection-inclusive sense is applied. Rhetorica WordNet derivational-family lookup was not executed.
records.research_method: Different forms from a common derivational family
records.research_scope: FindPolyptoton compares derivational-form sets and excludes identical forms.

records.label: Pleonasm
records.action: Did not execute the LanguageTool English redundancy phrase rule.
records.limitation: A finite source phrase list was researched; complete configured Java/runtime execution is unavailable here. No poem-wide absence claim.
records.research_method: An inspected English phrase list and rule class detect specified semantically redundant expressions.
records.research_scope: A finite lexical subset of pleonasm, disabled by default; context may make repetition deliberate or useful.

records.label: Parallelism
records.action: Manually compared promises to keep and miles to go; both have plural-noun + infinitival-clause form.
records.limitation: Exact repeated final line supplies additional trivial parallelism. The external parser-based algorithm was not executed.
records.research_method: An English parison algorithm supplies a scoped method for syntactic parallelism.
records.research_scope: Structural repetition only; broad semantic parallelism remains open. The separate Song2016 method is Chinese, not English evidence.

records.label: Isocolon
records.action: Compared the three-word noun-infinitive phrases and the identical final lines.
records.limitation: Three-word phrases differ in syllabic length (five versus three); exact duplicated lines do not independently establish an equal-cola construction. Rhetorica/Webis isocolon routines were not executed.
records.research_method: Comparison of grammatical structures and lengths
records.research_scope: Rhetorica and Webis isocolon methods; equal-colon interpretation follows the selected implementation.

records.label: Parison
records.action: Supplied manually reviewed grammatical shape for the two parallel noun-infinitive phrases.
records.limitation: The published full phrase-policy/constituent-tree algorithm was not run; this is supporting syntactic analysis, not a claim of native Parison detection.
records.research_method: The published English procedure matches constituent-branch structure and grammatical tags between eligible phrases.
records.research_scope: Exact syntactic matching under the paper's phrase policy; parser errors and nonexact parallelism remain limitations.

records.label: Bicolon
records.action: Reviewed the two final repeated units and the parallel noun-infinitive phrases.
records.limitation: A broad two-part description is available; the Webis two-isocolon branch was not executed and equal independent cola were not established.
records.research_method: Two-part isocolon branch
records.research_scope: Actual annotateIsocolon branch. Common Isocolon output needs subtype mapping; nested-result suppression needs adaptation.

records.label: Tricolon
records.action: Manually reviewed every sentence for the researched equal-structure three-colon construction; none established.
records.limitation: Lovely, dark and deep is a three-adjective list, not three equal clauses. A loose three-part-list use of tricolon remains a possible terminology choice; the Webis branch was not executed.
records.research_method: Three-part isocolon branch
records.research_scope: Actual annotateIsocolon branch, not merely the weaker comma-only tricolon cue in another project.

records.label: Tetracolon
records.action: Manually reviewed every sentence for the researched equal-structure four-colon construction; none established.
records.limitation: A quatrain is not automatically tetracolon. The Webis branch was not executed.
records.research_method: Four-part isocolon branch
records.research_scope: Actual annotateIsocolon branch. Counted separately because the master lists tetracolon separately.

records.label: Chiasmus
records.action: Executed PRD’s lexical chiasmus candidate rule in all four modes (no outputs), then manually reviewed clause/phrase structure for grammatical reversal.
records.limitation: The PRD rule is a lexical candidate routine, not proof of broad grammatical coverage; Rhetorica structural chiasmus was not run. No local grammatical ABBA structure was established.
records.research_method: Grammatical-structure reversal
records.research_scope: FindChiasmus targets structural reversal; this does not claim coverage of every conceptual chiasmus.

records.label: Antimetabole
records.action: Enumerated strict one-sentence content-word ABBA candidates over all six sentences; no candidate survives.
records.limitation: Declared one-word A/B units and local stoplist. This does not exhaust multiword or conceptual reversal; native Rhetorica not run.
records.research_method: Lexical reversal
records.research_scope: Separate antimetabole implementation; additional ABBA candidate/ranking research was inspected.

records.label: Ellipsis
records.action: Reviewed the ending’s shared I have construction and sound’s contraction.
records.limitation: Shared-verb noun-phrase coordination and sound is contraction do not by themselves establish the researched VP-ellipsis subtype. ViPER was not available; broader literary omission remains open.
records.research_method: Explicit English knowledge-based rules detect selected VP ellipsis; UD supplies an annotation representation for additional grammatical ellipsis.
records.research_scope: This confirms scoped methods, not all rhetorical omission, reliable poem-wide recall or publicly runnable ViPER software.

records.label: Polysyndeton
records.action: Executed PRD polysyndeton. Sentence mode emits and in L13, L15, L16; manual scope review separates adjective and noun-phrase coordination.
records.limitation: The raw mixed-level match is not presented as proven excessive same-level conjunction repetition. Repeated And at final line openings belongs to the exact doubling.
records.research_method: Repeated conjunctions
records.research_scope: Concrete polysyndeton methods in Rhetorica, PRD and Webis; unit/threshold policies remain explicit.

records.label: Apposition
records.action: Applied the reviewed apposition diagnostics manually throughout the poem; no co-referring noun-phrase apposition established.
records.limitation: The darkest evening of the year is a temporal adjunct, not a renaming of frozen lake. No parser run.
records.research_method: Explicit apposition diagnostics and a typed dependency provide a repeatable English annotation procedure.
records.research_scope: Restricted syntactic apposition; excludes title/name and other constructions the guidelines distinguish.

records.label: Parataxis
records.action: Applied the juxtaposed independent-clause diagnostic to the L2 semicolon and L3–4 clause.
records.limitation: Manual structural reading, not an automatic UD parse.
records.research_method: Official guidelines identify paratactic clause relations and encode them with a typed edge.
records.research_scope: Only the juxtaposed-clause subtype is confirmed; UD also uses this edge for bylines, reporting parentheticals and tag questions.

records.label: Hypotaxis
records.action: Identified finite before-clauses, the embedded if-question, and nonfinite dependent purpose/extraposed clauses with exact spans.
records.limitation: Manual structural annotation. CorpusSearch requires trees and was not executed.
records.research_method: CorpusSearch queries identify a declared set of finite subordinate and infinitival clauses in Penn-style trees.
records.research_scope: Structural hypotaxis given annotated input; English historical corpora are supported. Not a raw-text parser or a verdict about literary style.

records.label: Syncope
records.action: No LaROS lexical lookup was run.
records.limitation: The published method depends on a finite prelisted cut-form lexicon; the complete English list and runnable implementation were not recovered. No absence claim follows.
records.research_method: Published LaROS procedure scans raw text for prelisted medial-cut forms and applies the Syncope rule.
records.research_scope: Finite lexical lookup only; no general deletion detector, complete lexicon or runnable package recovered.

records.label: Apocope
records.action: No LaROS lexical lookup was run.
records.limitation: The published method depends on a finite prelisted cut-form lexicon; the complete English list and runnable implementation were not recovered. No absence claim follows.
records.research_method: Published LaROS procedure scans raw text for prelisted final-cut forms and applies the Apocope rule.
records.research_scope: Finite lexical lookup only; no general deletion detector, complete lexicon or runnable package recovered.

records.label: Enjambment
records.action: Executed the unchanged JaDe punctuation gate on every line, then manually reviewed each candidate’s actual grammar; all 15 boundaries have punctuation/grammar/pause fields.
records.limitation: Upstream POS/dependency classifier was not run. Strong and loose continuation are distinguished; no performed-pause claim.
records.research_method: JaDe implements English enjambment rules over POS tags and dependency edges crossing marked line boundaries.
records.research_scope: A bounded English verse prototype: punctuation-ending lines are skipped; selected grammatical patterns are recognized; priority logic suppresses alternatives. In addition, processor constructs dependency_dict with token.text as key, so repeated word occurrences can overwrite one another and corrupt positional reasoning. This is a source-level inference, not an executed failure claim.

records.label: Rhythmic patterning
records.action: Counted vowels in the preserved pronunciation realization at every line; retained the existing editorial metrical grid.
records.limitation: This is syllable-count/input verification. Prosodic automated scansion was not executed; it is not a new metrical analysis.
records.research_method: Inspected code derives weak/strong patterns, foot spans and substituted foot direction relative to line headedness.
records.research_scope: Scansion is pronunciation/reading dependent; code not run here and does not resolve every legitimate alternative.

records.label: Metrical variation
records.action: Preserved the existing editorial pronunciation and metrical alternatives without rerunning Prosodic.
records.limitation: The external scansion runtime/model dependencies are unavailable. This run does not claim exhaustive performance alternatives.
records.research_method: Inspected code derives weak/strong patterns, foot spans and substituted foot direction relative to line headedness.
records.research_scope: Scansion is pronunciation/reading dependent; code not run here and does not resolve every legitimate alternative.

records.label: Acrostic
records.action: Extracted all 16 line initials as WHHTMTBTHTTOTBAA.
records.limitation: AcrosticSleuth meaningfulness ranking and English resources were not executed. Initial extraction alone is not an acrostic finding.
records.research_method: Initial-letter candidates are ranked for meaningfulness using unigram token probabilities versus a chance-character model.
records.research_scope: English LINE/WORD modes; statistical ranking is not proof of authorial intention. Length and repetition filters limit recall.

records.label: Anagram
records.action: Compared exact normalized letter multisets for all 5778 word-occurrence pairs, excluding identical spellings; no nontrivial distinct-word anagram pair.
records.limitation: Scope is complete individual words, not every arbitrary phrase/subsequence in the poem. Source-predicate adaptation, not the upstream JavaScript package.
records.research_method: Exact anagram predicate
records.research_scope: Letter multiset/count comparison on selected sequences; normalization and candidate enumeration remain implementation choices.

records.label: Palindrome
records.action: Checked every whole word of at least two letters, all full lines, and the full poem for normalized reversal equality; no match.
records.limitation: One-letter I and a are deliberately excluded as trivial. Arbitrary cross-word substrings are not exhaustively enumerated. Source-predicate adaptation.
records.research_method: Exact palindrome predicate
records.research_scope: Sequence reversal/equality on selected strings, under an explicit normalization policy.

records.label: Lipogram
records.action: Computed the exact absent ASCII-letter set for the whole poem, excluding title: j, x.
records.limitation: A physical letter omission is established; there is no evidence it was an intended lipogram. New set-comparison implementation, not upstream Rust execution.
records.research_method: An inspected function checks the exact set of absent English letters.
records.research_scope: Use a nonempty declared omission set and a punctuation policy; physical absence does not prove intentional constraint.

records.label: Pangram
records.action: Computed the whole-poem ASCII-letter set; missing j, x means it is not a pangram.
records.limitation: Case-folded a–z, punctuation ignored, title excluded. New exact-predicate implementation.
records.research_method: Inspected code verifies all 26 English letters and separately identifies one-occurrence perfect pangrams.
records.research_scope: ASCII English alphabet, case-folded; this checks a formal property without claiming literary intent.
